FaqPage.title: FAQ
FaqPage.a1: Nowly es una extensión de navegador que actualiza automáticamente tu estado de Discord (Rich Presence) con lo que estás viendo en tus plataformas de streaming favoritas. Se compone de una extensión para Chromium, un host de mensajería nativo para Windows y un sitio web. Todo el proyecto es de código abierto y gratuito.
FaqPage.a2: Sí, Nowly es completamente gratuito. El proyecto es desarrollado por dos personas en su tiempo libre. Si deseas apoyar el proyecto, puedes hacer una donación a través de Ko-fi, pero es completamente opcional: todas las funciones son y seguirán siendo gratuitas.
FaqPage.a3:
La instalación consta de dos pasos:
Paso 1: instala la extensión desde Chrome Web Store.
Paso 2: descarga y ejecuta el instalador de Windows (la aplicación nativa que se comunica con Discord).
Una vez instalados ambos, Nowly funciona automáticamente en segundo plano. No necesitas configurar nada más.
FaqPage.a4:
Nowly actualmente es compatible con YouTube, Twitch, Disney+, Apple TV+ y Prime Video.

Se añaden nuevas plataformas regularmente a través de las actualizaciones de la extensión. Estas presencias son creadas tanto por el equipo principal como por los colaboradores de la comunidad. Cualquier persona puede proponer o crear una nueva presencia — consulta el repositorio de GitHub para contribuir.

Visita la biblioteca para ver la lista completa y el estado de desarrollo de cada presencia.
FaqPage.a5: La aplicación nativa de Nowly se comunica directamente con el cliente de Discord instalado en tu ordenador a través de una tubería nominada de Windows (IPC). Ningún dato pasa por nuestros servidores. Nowly simplemente envía la información de tu actividad actual (título, plataforma, duración) a Discord, que la muestra en tu perfil.
FaqPage.q6: ¿Comparten mis datos con servidores de terceros?
FaqPage.a6: No. Todo se procesa localmente en tu máquina. La extensión detecta el contenido en tu navegador y transmite la información a la aplicación nativa, que la envía directamente a Discord mediante comunicación local. Ninguno de tus datos personales o de tu actividad se envía a nuestros servidores. Solo se almacenan estadísticas agregadas (número de instalaciones, valoración) para cada presencia.
FaqPage.q7: ¿Por qué no se actualiza mi estado de Discord?
FaqPage.a7:
Varias razones posibles:

• ¿Está Discord ejecutándose en tu ordenador?
• ¿Está la aplicación nativa de Nowly instalada y en ejecución?
• ¿Está la extensión activada en tu navegador?
• ¿Está la presencia para tu plataforma instalada desde la biblioteca?

También puedes abrir el panel lateral de la extensión para ver los mensajes de depuración.
FaqPage.a8: Para desinstalar la extensión, haz clic derecho en el icono de Nowly en tu navegador y selecciona 'Eliminar de Chrome'. Para desinstalar la aplicación nativa, ejecuta el programa desinstalador disponible en la carpeta de instalación o usa el Panel de control de Windows.
FaqPage.a9: Sí, el código fuente completo de Nowly está disponible en GitHub. Puedes explorar el código, sugerir mejoras, reportar errores o contribuir al desarrollo del proyecto.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: Nowly is designed with your privacy as a priority. The application runs almost entirely locally on your machine — no personal data about you is collected, stored, or shared with our servers. This policy explains what information is processed, where, and why.
PrivacyPage.s01body: Nowly consists of three parts: a browser extension, a Windows native application, and a website (marketplace). The extension detects media content in your browser and passes it to the native app, which sends it directly to the Discord client on your machine via a local Windows named pipe (IPC). None of this data ever touches our servers.
PrivacyPage.s02body:
The browser extension stores the following data locally in chrome.storage.local — it never leaves your machine:

• Installed presences (metadata, signed bundles, activation state).
• Current activity (content title, platform, duration, thumbnail).
• A debug log (timestamps, actions, visited URLs).
• Onboarding state and a local snapshot of your Discord profile (ID, username, avatar) used solely for UI display.
• Display preferences and per-presence settings.

This data stays on your device and can be erased by uninstalling the extension or by using the reset option in the extension settings.
PrivacyPage.s03title: Data Processed by the Native Application
PrivacyPage.s03body: The native Nowly application writes a log file to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NowlyClient\nowly-host.log containing timestamps and activity information sent to Discord. This file is stored locally, can be deleted at any time, and is never sent to our servers.
PrivacyPage.s04body:
The Nowly website uses Vercel Analytics for anonymous audience measurement. No third-party cookies, cross-site trackers, or profiling tools are used. Collected data is limited to:

• Pages visited and visit duration.
• Device type and browser (non-identifying information).
• Approximate country (inferred from IP, which is not stored).

No personally identifiable information is collected through the website.
PrivacyPage.s05body:
A Redis database (hosted on Upstash) stores aggregated, anonymous statistics for each presence:

• Total installation count.
• Active user count.
• Average rating (rating sum and vote count).
• Current version, creation date, and last update date.

These statistics cannot identify any individual user. They exist solely to inform you about each presence's popularity and status.
PrivacyPage.s06body:
Nowly communicates with the Discord client via a local IPC interface. The following information may be transmitted to Discord solely for displaying your Rich Presence:

• The platform name (e.g. YouTube).
• The content title you are watching.
• The channel or author name.
• Playback state (playing / paused).
• Duration and elapsed time.

This information is visible to anyone who can see your Discord profile. Nowly has no control over how Discord processes this data once received. Please refer to Discord's Privacy Policy for more details.
PrivacyPage.s07body:
Nowly uses the following third-party services:

• Vercel — website hosting and anonymous analytics.
• Upstash — Redis database hosting (aggregated statistics).
• Chrome Web Store — browser extension distribution.
• Ko-fi — donation platform (no personal data is shared with Ko-fi by Nowly).
• Discord — Rich Presence display (local communication only).
PrivacyPage.s08body: The Nowly website does not use any cookies for tracking or profiling purposes. No third-party cookies are set. Language preference is preserved through Next.js routing (no persistent cookies).
PrivacyPage.s09body: Presence packages are cryptographically signed (ECDSA P-256) before distribution. The extension verifies the signature before installing or running any presence, ensuring only authorized code executes on your machine.
PrivacyPage.s10body: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data. Since no personal data is collected on our servers, these rights are exercised locally by uninstalling the extension or deleting the native application log files.
PrivacyPage.s11body: For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out via the GitHub repository or on Ko-fi.

TosPage.title: Terms of Service
TosPage.s01body: By downloading, installing, or using Nowly (the browser extension, native application, website, and any associated software), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the software.
TosPage.s02body:
Nowly is an open-source tool that detects media content in your browser and automatically updates your Discord status (Rich Presence) via local communication with the Discord client. The service consists of:

• A Chromium browser extension that detects and reports your activity.
• A Windows native application that acts as a gateway to Discord.
• A website (marketplace) for discovering and installing presences.
• A developer SDK and tooling for creating custom presences.
TosPage.s03body: Nowly is distributed as open-source software. You are permitted to use, copy, modify, and redistribute it in accordance with the applicable license (available in the GitHub repository). This license does not apply to content from third-party platforms (YouTube, Twitch, etc.) that you choose to display via Nowly.
TosPage.s04body:
You agree to use Nowly in compliance with applicable laws and Discord's Terms of Service. Specifically, you must not:

• Use Nowly to display illegal, hateful, or inappropriate content.
• Attempt to bypass the security mechanisms of the extension or native application.
• Distribute modified or unsigned presences through the official infrastructure.
• Use Nowly in a way that violates the terms of service of Discord or any streaming platform you access.
TosPage.s05body: The Nowly source code is subject to its applicable open-source license. All third-party trademarks, logos, and platform names (YouTube, Twitch, Disney+, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Discord) remain the property of their respective owners. Nowly is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Discord Inc. or any of the supported streaming platforms.
TosPage.s06body:
Nowly is provided "as is", without any warranty, express or implied. The author shall not be held liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use or inability to use the software, including but not limited to:

• Malfunction of Discord or your status display.
• Suspension or restriction of your Discord account by Discord Inc.
• Loss of data stored locally by the extension.
• Any indirect damage related to the use of the native application.
TosPage.s07body: Your use of Nowly is governed by our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated into these Terms of Service. We encourage you to read it carefully before using the service.
TosPage.s08body: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon publication on this page. It is your responsibility to review this page periodically. Continued use of Nowly after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
TosPage.s09body: For any questions regarding these Terms of Service, please reach out via the GitHub repository or on Ko-fi.
